selection.inner: leave one of eight training regions out
selection.scaling: training-only population SD, zero SD -> 1, response centered
selection.rule: largest lambda within pooled minimum RMSE + regional delete-one jackknife SE at minimum; abs tie 1e-10
selection.solver: unchanged archived LARS/interpolation with training-only primal-dual certification and QR equivalent repair
selection.BIC: n*log(RSS/n)+(q+1)*log(n), n equals actual training selection rows

fitting.aggregation: mean of six strips per image

representation_definitions.continuous: float32 RGB * (float32 clipped ExG /255), clip, uint8 truncation; original implementation
representation_definitions.otsu: image-specific OpenCV THRESH_BINARY+THRESH_OTSU on clipped uint8 ExG, no morphology
representation_definitions.coordinates: same existing six adaptive strip coordinates for all three
representation_definitions.feature_arithmetic: float64; all pixels; exact-zero denominator -> 0; final formulas in src/feature_extraction.py
representation_definitions.normalization: complexity, mean_R/G/B and IPCAS /255; original centered start/end

partition_sensitivity.matched: left selected three strips outer span split in three, right selected three span split in three
partition_sensitivity.secondary: six full-width equal strips, floor(linspace(0,width,7)); coverage differs

EVIgreen: int32 D=14R+4G-13B; float64 5(G-R)/D when D!=0; zero only at D==0; no epsilon/clipping/winsorization
recurrence: All features attaining the observed maximum count in nine final BIC sets; no threshold
